cues.text: Each bar is the p95 latency of its bucket.
Around two o'clock an incident pushes the tail up.
Click any bar to inspect its requests.

terms.title: Binning
terms.body: Two hundred thousand requests are too many marks to draw per frame. @moritzbrantner/charts aggregates them once into 48 buckets with counts and percentiles; the video only animates those 48 bars.

terms.title: p95 latency
terms.body: 95% of requests in the bucket finished faster than this. Unlike the average, it shows the slow tail that users actually notice.

terms.title: The incident
terms.body: Between 14:00 and 15:30 the dataset injects a heavier latency tail and 503 errors. Click one of the orange bars to see the slowest requests in that window.

payload.heading: Where did the slow requests come from?
